headlines.text: Looking back to 2022, when the AEW Women's World Title changed hands as Thunder Rosa vs. Britt Baker battled it out in a Steel Cage match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.88 ? ending the champion's reign at 8 defenses. A violent, historic rematch ? only the third-ever steel cage match in AEW history, and the first involving women ? Rosa ended Baker's 290-day reign with a Thunder Driver Slam in front of her own adopted hometown crowd, capping a rivalry that began with an equally brutal Lights Out war exactly a year earlier.
It was 2024 when Bryan Danielson vs. Katsuyori Shibata delivered a match fans still talk about on Collision, rated 8.59.
Flash back to 2022, when Jeff Hardy touched down in AEW for the first time, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.70.
